reviewed_guards: published_corpus refreshes persistent employee/documents/revisions; ACTIVE document, current active_revision_id PUBLISHED, effective date and conjunctive site/legal/type/stage/audience/sensitivity restrictions precede retrieval
SQL permitted chunk IDs bound Qdrant responses; contextual extraction parent matches revision; native spans and HR-authored reviewed FIGURE image hashes supply exact citation evidence components

Complement selection keeps evidence/citations in same index order; literal output retains full parent text including NOT/conjunction/antecedents; oversize returns explicit HANDOFF rather than clipping rules
Generation sees retrieved source evidence with empty history; follow-up resolution reads only previous user question, not previous assistant facts
Before ordinary final result, current published access is checked; HTTP answer/message reads and transport presend independently reauthorize citations and employee/episode/mode/binding
No document name, specific physical page, source UUID or case answer hardcoded in reviewed retrieval policy; vocabulary/intent patterns are generic and full module SHA pins constants/helpers
limits: This is narrow code review and deterministic synthetic validation, not model/corpus semantic acceptance, independent penetration test, or proof of all future documents.
Source14 actual extended regression review, native activation, HTTP100 and current-image operational proofs remain separate required evidence.
Substantive-content and complementary-section detection remain bounded heuristics; exact copied source does not itself prove complete coverage of arbitrary unseen policy.
